originalTitle: American Horror Story: 13 | Official Trailer | FX
content: OFFICIAL TRAILER. We’re so back, witches. FX’s AHS: 13 premieres 9.24 on FX | Hulu. Subscribe now for more American Horror Story clips: http://bit.ly/SubscribeFX | Visit Official Site http://fx.tv/AHS Subscribe to https://www.youtube.com/@AmericanHorrorStory for more. #AmericanHorrorStory #AHS #FX FX’s “American Horror Story,” the global phenomenon that has garnered more than 100 Emmy nominations since its launch in 2011, returns for an unrivaled 13th installment that will do justice to everyone’s most feared number. Bringing together an all-star cast, many of whom are reprising fan favorite roles, “AHS: 13” continues to build on the anthology’s decades-long legacy that has been streamed more than 700 million hours across the globe and spawned a legion of dedicated fans. Created and produced by Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk, “American Horror Story” has redefined the genre with various installments featuring a creepy murder house, a coven of witches, a traveling freak show, a haunted hotel and the apocalypse itself. Which iconic horrors will return to haunt the hallowed halls of 13 and what new terrors await? Light your candles, draw your pentagrams and prepare for a supreme surprise. “American Horror Story” is an award-winning franchise, the progenitor of the modern-day limited series format and the longest running hour-long series in FX’s history. The series is produced by 20th Television. chineseContent: 官方预告片。我们回来了，女巫们。 FX 的 AHS：13 首映 9.24 FX |葫芦。立即订阅更多美国恐怖故事剪辑：http://bit.ly/SubscribeFX |访问官方网站 http://fx.tv/AHS 订阅 https://www.youtube.com/@AmericanHorrorStory 了解更多信息。 #AmericanHorrorStory #AHS #FX FX 出品的《美国恐怖故事》自 2011 年推出以来已获得超过 100 项艾美奖提名，现已在全球掀起热潮，以无与伦比的第 13 部作品回归，公正地展现了每个人最恐惧的恐怖故事。 《美国恐怖故事：13》汇集了全明星演员阵容，其中许多人重新演绎了粉丝最喜爱的角色，继续以该选集数十年的传统为基础，该剧已在全球播放超过 7 亿小时，并吸引了大批忠实粉丝。由瑞恩·墨菲和布拉德·法尔查克创作和制作的《美国恐怖故事》重新定义了这一类型，其中包括令人毛骨悚然的谋杀屋、女巫集会、巡回怪胎表演、闹鬼的酒店和世界末日本身。哪些标志性的恐怖将再次出现在 13 人的神圣大厅中，还有哪些新的恐怖等待着您？点燃蜡烛，画出五角星，准备迎接终极惊喜。 《美国恐怖故事》是一部屡获殊荣的系列剧，是现代限量剧集格式的鼻祖，也是 FX 历史上播出时间最长的一小时剧集。该剧由 20th Television 制作。观看《美国恐怖故事》第 12 季视频：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLIDyzBpnfjqmnwXBzY2_umw9fZf5ndQ1T 在 Facebook 上喜欢《美国恐怖故事》：https://facebook.com/AmericanHorrorStory 在 X 上关注《美国恐怖故事》：https://twitter.com/AHSFX 在 Instagram 上关注《美国恐怖故事》：http://instagram.com/ahsFX Instagram 上的 FX：http://instagram.com/FXNetworks
